public.title: Decode String
public.description: Decode a valid expression containing lowercase ASCII letters and repetitions count[expression]. Counts are positive decimal integers; brackets may nest. Concatenation is implicit. encoded has 0 to 200 characters, nesting depth at most 20, and decoded output at most 2000 characters.
hints: Parse a bracketed expression recursively, stopping at its closing bracket.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Accumulate literals and expand recursively parsed groups by their counts. Work is bounded by encoded input and expanded intermediate output.
